change.behavior: When S2B_INGEST_MODE=worker and the desktop launcher starts its own API, it starts a worker with the same resolved data root and stops both owned processes when the native window closes. It does not attach a worker to an already-running API because that API's data root cannot be verified. The local in-process mode remains the default.

verification.command: python -m pytest backend/tests/test_desktop_app.py -q -p no:tmpdir -k 'worker or waits_for_native_window'
notes: The test run emitted the existing Starlette/httpx deprecation warning.
Pytest's cache directory was not writable in this Windows sandbox; this did not affect the four test results.
